# Derivative Media

> Web design and development studio in Colwyn Bay, North Wales, run by Tom Patel. Hand-coded websites, bilingual Welsh and English sites, community council websites, local SEO and AI search optimisation for businesses, councils and charities across North Wales.

## Services
- [Websites for North Wales businesses](https://derivativemedia.co.uk/websites): what a good small-business site needs, cost drivers, process, choosing a developer
- [Bilingual Welsh and English websites](https://derivativemedia.co.uk/websites/bilingual)
- [Community council websites in Wales](https://derivativemedia.co.uk/for/community-councils)
- [Local SEO and AI search](https://derivativemedia.co.uk/local-seo)
